# Rust Compiler Cleanup — September 7, 2026

## Scope

Reopened via repo MCP `ticket_reopen` after reading `repo://goals`. The existing AI-optimized Repo goal remains associated with this ticket. The user requires `s` and all plugins to compile without warnings or errors.

The shipping build includes the native WGPU renderer, the browser WGPU renderer (`wasm32-unknown-unknown`), and plugin and extension components (`wasm32-wasip2`, `wasm-dev` profile). Native test compilation is included to catch test-only regressions. The previous ticket did not finish these surfaces; its earlier exceptions are not considered success for this request.

## Method

- Preserve concurrent changes and make no modifying Git operations.
- Capture compiler diagnostics before editing; resolve underlying causes without warning suppression.
- Run builds through Bun/Nx, with two Cargo jobs and an isolated ticket target directory.
- Keep generated diagnostics and build artifacts in `🗑️generated` until verification ends, then remove them.
- Record actual executed checks and counts below; no passing claim before completion.

## Checks

Native workspace all-target compilation baseline started. Results pending.

### Initial Native Workspace Pass Completed

`bun x nx exec --projects=workspace -- cargo check --workspace --all-targets --keep-going -j 2 --message-format=json` exited 101 (Nx exited 1). It recorded 9859 warning diagnostics and 3376 error diagnostics across all native targets. These are diagnostic counts, including repeated library/test messages. Sources were being corrected during this pass, so it is discovery evidence, not final-state verification.

The empty-enum regression emitted the expected unreachable-call diagnostic before the derive fix. Its fixture include path was corrected and `unreachable_code` is now denied at integration-crate scope. An executable regression run is in progress.

The run host now awaits asynchronous blob, plugin router, compatibility, and transaction APIs. Actor turn completion uses the actor kernel result directly and preserves cold-pair and lifecycle receipts. Layout snapshot JSON now uses the existing local ToValue/FromValue codec. All require fresh compiler verification.

### Enum Regression Passed

The `deny_unknown_fields_enums` integration target ran successfully: **15 passed, 0 failed, 0 ignored**, exit 0, and **zero compiler diagnostics** in the captured JSON stream. The new language-neutral empty/unit enum cases matched serde, with the expected `[DEBUG]` runtime evidence.

Executed `cargo check -p semio-framework-os-run -p semio-framework-ui -p semio-framework-os-kernel-db --lib --keep-going -j2 --message-format=json` through Bun/Nx with incremental compilation disabled. Exit 0 after 4m55s: 204 warnings, 0 errors across the dependency graph. This confirms native type checking of the runner/API repairs, but is not a warning-free result and does not replace runtime tests.

### Borrowed Slice Codec Regression

Added a neutral slice corpus and serde oracle test. Before the implementation, the test compilation failed with E0277 (`[i64]: ToValue` missing and implicit Sized bound). Added slice encoding, reused it from Vec/array encoders, and relaxed `to_dsl_value` to accept unsized inputs. The subsequent full replication test run executed 256 tests: 254 passed including the new slice test and mutation metadata tests, 2 existing float-format tests failed (`every_finite_f32_round_trips_bit_exactly_and_prints_like_serde_json`, `f32_widens_through_its_own_shortest_lexeme_not_its_bits`). Overall exit 1; this is not a passing suite.

### Aggregate Evaluation Follow-up

Architect still exceeded the constant-evaluation limit in the selected plugin pass. The derive already fully validates each descriptor and source in an independent constant, so the final aggregate check now performs cross-leaf uniqueness and completeness without repeating all per-leaf path scans. The general full-roster validator retains its checks and shares the uniqueness routine. Pending fresh tests and Architect compilation.

### Decimal Float and Metadata Regression Results

Executed protocol-derive-test4 through Bun/Nx: exit 0, replication 256 passed, DSL derive 14 passed, no compiler warnings/errors. The 200,000-pattern float sweep now retains f32 bits and matches serde's decimal values, including halfway rounding. Prior test runs exposed formatting-threshold, parser-rounding and midpoint differences; those runs failed and are not counted as passing.

Removed three unused private DB operations after verifying no source callers: MemWalRangeCopy and its factory, db_io_memory_list_cursor, and database_sync_hello_envelope_credit, in storage/🦀️.rs and sync/🦀️.rs. Their active retained-operation implementations remain in place.

The new scope regression first failed with E0599 for the missing validate method. Shared root, filename and layout validation now produces an immutable validated scope; per-leaf checks retain descriptor, identity, workspace and exact source-path checks. After correcting the derive expansion assertion for the new method name, validated-scope-after2 passed: replication 256 tests and derive 14 tests, exit 0, no compiler diagnostics. The full native pass is pending.

Native-shipping2 completed with 815 warnings and 50 errors; Architect no longer reported long_running_const_eval. Its scope validation still took several minutes, motivating the shared scope change. Energy library source checking completed without errors. Renderer library checked, while its native executable had two parsing faults in unsafe-block comparisons; those comparisons are now parenthesized for both Unix and Windows. This was not a successful overall build.

### Remaining Unused Parser Closures and Delta Parameters

Removed unused malformed-error closures and named intentionally unused base/payload parameters in direct delta and relation-check implementations.

## Native and WASI Check Progress

Native-shipping3 completed with 539 warnings and 168 errors across the selected packages. Its obsolete synchronous category wrappers were corrected afterward. Native-renderer4 completed successfully with 606 warnings and no errors, including the native binary with native-bin. Wasi-energy completed successfully with 175 warnings and no errors. These are type checks, not completed component/link/runtime verification. The browser renderer check is now running.

Workflow inverses that derive their result solely from the payload now name the unused base argument explicitly. Surface resize rejection close still takes the retained operation but no longer evaluates an ignored Boolean.

The initial mutation-vector test build stopped in a concurrently changed kernel codec before compiling DAG (two Send errors); the earlier native check directly demonstrated both missing mutation metadata implementations. Config and presence now have explicit JSON schemas, source-owned descriptors and direct MutationKind leaves. Aggregate metadata is derived from those leaves, and all Rust callers use the new semantic vocabulary. Camera and locale inverses retain only their changed fields. The JSON oracle vectors and codec/inverse laws will be rerun.

### Complete Warning Gate Scope

The new language-neutral scope fixture failed against the old implementation because native renderer coverage was missing. The updated Nx gate passed three target vectors, two rejected-target vectors, and an independent Cargo metadata comparison covering all 59 plugin/extension crates. Native checks enable the renderer binary; browser checks include the renderer. The launch configurations now call the Nx target, including a scope-only validation entry. Full warning-free compilation remains incomplete.

Changed: root script, launch.json, and the Rust warning scope JSON fixture.

### WASI Fleet Repairs

The 59-crate WASI check exposed a browser-scoped RefCell import used by shared map caches and asynchronous extension builder methods with no suspension points. Made the shared import unconditional, restored immediate pure builder operations, and removed their ready-future wrappers. The control extension bundle constructor now follows the synchronous builder contract shared by the other extensions.

### First DAG Runtime Test Result

The complete DAG library test run compiled with zero errors and 128 warnings, then ran 189 tests: 125 passed and 64 failed. The new config/presence mutation vectors passed. Most failures came from the plugin codec expecting hex JSON while both the committed demo and the framework graph codec use the same structured DSL. Replaced the divergent text implementation with the existing canonical graph codec through the artifact-owned conversion boundary. Added a handcrafted JSON oracle for the demo nodes and edges, parsed independently with Serde. Tests must be rerun.

### Aggregate Source Ownership Investigation

The WASI compile reports aggregate-source const failures for Mathematical (15 leaves) and Note (33 leaves). Mathematical explicitly imports graph/geometry/equation mutation leaves from separate owning subsets while its aggregate remains under the any subset. The current Mutations derive constructs only one validated source scope from its own directory, so it rejects those deliberately separated leaves. Draw has the same split but also lacks MutationLeaf metadata on fourteen leaves. A clean fix must explicitly declare the aggregate’s component source roots while preserving exact workspace, taxonomy, source-path, descriptor, semantic identity, and roster uniqueness checks. No ownership validation has been weakened and no source-composition change has yet been implemented.

### Latest DAG Runtime and Fleet Results

`dag-tests-after2` compiled without errors. The new canonical demo JSON oracle, snapshot DSL/pack round trips, and configuration/presence vectors passed before the full suite aborted during app initialization. The tool proof declared `dag-play` while the canonical controller is `s.dag.dag@1/*#editor`; a bare test registry also omitted migrated declarations. Corrected the controller used by proofs and action factories, declared the locale view action, and wired the test helper to the real registry.

Two isolated pre-existing runtime failures remain: disconnect inverse reorders edges and thus changes the content child identity; the command-envelope test applies through a store without the now-required mutation retirement factory. No full DAG test pass is claimed.

The fourth WASI fleet check reports 833 errors and 854 warnings across 59 selected plugin/extension packages. Mathematical module/registration edits and String printing fixes were made after that pass and need a fresh compile. All compilation targets remain unfinished.

### Explicit Aggregate Component Sources

Added `mutationAggregateSources` to the taxonomy authority. Six aggregate roots explicitly name their physical mutation collections: Mathematical, Note, FEM 2D and 3D, Sequence, and Drawing. The derive validates safe canonical roots, rejects empty/duplicate/malformed declarations and missing or symbolic-link sources, and retains per-leaf workspace, taxonomy, descriptor, physical source, semantic kind, and global wire-identity uniqueness checks. Explicit domain-operation components must contribute every registered operation. Sources are direct physical collections; declarations do not recursively inherit another aggregate’s authority.

The new language-neutral ten-case source fixture reproduced the missing component scope before implementation. After decoding quoted Rust string literals through Syn for the oracle comparison, all 15 derive tests passed (`aggregate-sources-after2`), including existing ownership, mandatory descriptor, and SHA-256 oracle tests. A complete WASI fleet compile is running to verify real aggregate const evaluation.

Files: `🧰️framework/🛍️products/💻️os/🔨️modules/🗣️dsl/✨️derive/🦀️.rs`, its `🧪️tests/🏛️mutation-aggregate-source-authority/🧫️fixtures/🧩️sources.json`, and `🧰️framework/🛍️products/🦑️repo/🔨️modules/📚️library/🔣️taxonomy.json`.

### Mathematical UI and Configuration

Updated graph, geometry, and table renderers to fallible contract nodes and component trees. Added scene-payload assertions. Replaced the empty custom presence runtime with the framework NoPresence channel; its independent schema declaration remains. Corrected remaining equation field/array codec calls. Configuration operations now use two source-owned mutation leaves, explicit JSON schemas/descriptors, and a four-case neutral oracle covering field preservation, inverse, text/binary codecs, and unchanged values. The unchanged-value outcome now retains the current configuration rather than applying a default whole-record snapshot. These new Mathematical tests have not yet run.

### Forms Bounded JSON Calls

Scoped the existing Serde chunk oracle implementation to tests, implemented the missing first-party value conversion with the same 4,096-byte UTF-8 limit, and replaced runtime Serde JSON string calls with first-party codecs. Continuation arguments now serialize the declared SetTryValueStep payload directly. Corrected prefix iteration to use the existing content traversal. Added a seven-case language-neutral chunk fixture for ASCII, two-byte characters, four-byte characters, and a non-string rejection. This new Forms test is pending compilation; no pass is claimed.

Files: Forms `🎮️commands/🎯️set-try-value/🦀️.rs`, its `🧪️fixtures/🔣️chunks.json`, `🎮️commands/🗃️set-try-values/🦀️.rs`, and `🎚️config/🦀️.rs` under the any subset editor.

### Borrowed JSON Macro Regression and Mathematical Fixture Precision

The native pack regression reproduced four compiler errors: owned records and borrowed strings were not accepted as macro leaves, and the owned JSON value lacked ToValue/FromValue. The macro now borrows expressions and uses the first-party codec. JSON values and objects implement the corresponding structural conversion. Three language-neutral fixture vectors compare the result with serde_json, including Unicode and integer bounds. The red run failed compilation as expected; the green run is pending.

The Mathematical configuration vector test executed one test and failed because hand-authored floating-point camera expectations used integer JSON literals. The fixture now declares floating-point literals, matching the schema and serde oracle. Its rerun is pending.

Changed: pack JSON source, pack JSON macro-values fixture, and the Mathematical configuration mutation fixture.

### Owned JSON Green Verification

The actual native pack JSON test run completed: 39 passed, zero failed, zero compiler warnings or errors in the pack test invocation. This includes the new borrowed-record regression and differential parser/writer checks against serde_json. Mathematical native configuration verification is rebuilding after the shared JSON change. Trinity call sites now qualify pack::json!, use bounded semantic labels, convert selected UI identifiers to strings, and explicitly decode invalid optional JSON as null; the manifest declares the first-party UI contract and editor dependencies actually referenced by its source. These Trinity changes await the next full WASI check.

### Trinity Mutation Contract Vectors

Added four language-neutral suites covering 20 configuration/presence operations before refactoring their missing descriptor implementations. Every case checks payload serialization against serde_json, descriptor identity, exact post-state, inverse restoration, and text/binary round trips. Existing full WASI compilation already fails all four Mutation implementations because their descriptor contracts are absent. These new runtime tests have not yet been executed.

### Trinity Store and Board Interfaces

Trinity store creation, validated batch dispatch, undo/redo, drag commits, and query execution now await the store futures. The public board fixture loader accepts JSON text and decodes the typed internal fixture directly; its callers in Puzzle, Trinity, and the native renderer now use this first-party boundary. This removes the serde_json::Value requirement from that public API and avoids the renderer/browser double parse. Trinity force layout uses the existing JSON boundary around the framework implementation. Added two language-neutral board ingress fixtures with serde_json as the oracle; actual runtime verification remains pending. Fresh Trinity load-document effect encoding uses the same ready-future bridge already used for fresh edit-free envelopes in sibling plugins.

Trinity configuration/presence now has 20 physical mutation leaves, each with a JSON payload schema and descriptor. Four aggregate enums derive their metadata and dispatch from these leaves. All Rust constructors were updated to the physical record types. Native contract tests are queued behind the Mathematical build.

### Trinity Payload Schema Validation

Ajv 2020 validated all 20 language-neutral mutation payloads against their owning JSON schemas. This check passed; native behavior tests remain in progress.

Rustfmt parsed all 24 new Trinity mutation source files (20 leaves and four aggregates) without syntax errors. No formatting rewrite was applied.

### Pending Runtime Scope

Beyond the new configuration/presence and board fixtures, the changed Trinity asynchronous store path still needs the existing create/undo, drag, and rewriting tests to execute. Static inspection also found that Trinity UI action constants still use trinity-jack-play/trinity-rewriting-play while their declared dialects derive s.trinity.jack@1/*#editor and s.trinity.rewriting@1/*#editor. Those IDs have not been changed yet; verify the existing rendered editor tests and align them when fixing the observed runtime failure. Mathematical math_app still uses the bare testkit factory, unlike math_app_with_registry; the broader application tests remain unverified.

### Playbook and Forms Semantic Builder Surfaces

The Playbook editor/viewer now return the framework ComponentTree result and propagate bounded UI assembly errors. The Playbook and Forms blueprint windows construct the typed block-list scene through the existing scene builder and admit it as a semantic Surface. Their old local builder-controller configuration helpers are removed because the current surface contract owns action routing. The Playbook steps viewer forwards the current TreeWindowKit result, and retained byte counters now use the required u64 type. Existing render test assertions still need conversion from the old componentKind JSON representation to the semantic surface payload before their native run. The Playbook configuration Mutation descriptor implementation remains unresolved.

The Playbook and Forms semantic-surface assertions have now been converted to decode and compare the actual BlockListScene. These assertions have not yet been compiled or run.

### Playbook Config Contract Coverage

Added three physical mutation descriptors and payload schemas, plus neutral replacement, locale, and Unicode contribution vectors. The fixture-driven native test checks the first-party JSON, text, binary, descriptor, resulting config and inverse against serde_json. The earlier compiler run is red because PlaybookConfigMutation lacks the required descriptor contract; the new assertions still require execution.

Playbook configuration now owns typed ReplaceConfig, SetLocale and SetContributions leaves. Their schema-derived collection implements the descriptor contract, preserving exact config replacement for inverses. Updated both command producers and existing config tests. New physical Rust sources are alongside their schemas under config/🧬️schema/🧬️mutations. Native validation remains pending.

### Forms Semantic Control Vectors

Added 13 language-neutral question/control cases, with serde_json assertions of actual component kinds, accessible names, Change triggers and question ids. The old render return type cannot satisfy this new test; source conversion follows. These tests have not run yet.

### WASI Verification 57: Animate and Imperative

Cargo check completed successfully for both packages on wasm32-wasip2. Each plugin emitted zero warnings and zero errors. Shared dependencies emitted 61 warnings and 0 errors. Native selected laws remain running.

Shooting follow-up: the mutation entry point now calls the kernel/store reexport of the synchronous apply_mutation API, replacing an unresolved alias and obsolete resolve_ready. The constant work-item bound is widened to u64 for the execution contract. These two Shooting corrections still require a fresh compiler check alongside its larger remaining UI/config errors. Norm imports its generated dispatch macro through lexical module scope instead of an absolute macro-export path.

### Shooting Presence Contract

Added the physical replace-presence descriptor, strict JSON payload schema, and a language-neutral vector covering multiple shot IDs, Unicode, viewport coordinates, projection, and utility state. Ajv 2020 independently accepted the payload before implementing the derived mutation collection. The native law verifies descriptor identity, owned JSON decoding against Serde values, text/binary roundtrips, forward state, and inverse restoration. Native runtime verification is pending Shooting compilation. Shooting tree labels now cross the semantic UI boundary using fallible text admission; four panel sections use the same helper.

### Shooting Configuration Contract

Nine physical mutation descriptors and strict payload schemas cover config replacement, shot selection, model centering, fit revision, camera draft, camera, utility, locale, and defaults. Ajv validated all nine language-neutral payloads before implementation. The mutation collection now derives complete descriptor metadata and retains whole-config inverse semantics. Updated 23 construction sites to explicit payload types. Text/binary/JSON and inverse laws are prepared; native verification remains pending the UI port.

Updated 13 window chrome files and added a language-neutral action vector with independent Serde checks for both locales. ### Imperative Viewer Fixture Retirement

The independent main and script viewer laws reached their assertions but panicked when the populated fixture document released the final neural Dictionary owner. The captured backtrace identifies ProcedureFlowWorkingData under ArtifactChild at document teardown. Both tests now transfer their exact child owners into a test-only cold retirement helper, including nested paths and seed values. Production rendering is unchanged. Native verification is pending.

Nx concurrent graph creation requires a shared cache: the installed project-graph implementation waits for another process and then reads its cached graph. Enabled NX_CACHE_PROJECT_GRAPH in the ticket-specific workspace data directory; the next two Nx invocations completed successfully.

### Small Plugin Warnings 66

Removed unused serializer traits and obsolete DAG hex-codec helpers. Scoped GIS Serde oracles, Brep coverage tables, Mathematical conversion traits, Demonstrator fixture parsing and Lowpoly interaction test imports to tests. Removed unused CAD/GIS controller constants, an uncalled CAD reference projection and an uncalled Lowpoly shape-admission method after reference searches. DAG mutation tests now use the store-owned apply_mutation API, eliminating their unused kernel alias. Existing live render and admission paths are unchanged. Verification pending.

The optional future-backed running job variant and its slice cap now follow the already test-only future executor. ### Mounted Contract Initializer Correction

The native Architect and Energy builds found a second mounted-operation initializer using the removed contract copy. Removed that initializer after the compiler identified it. These runs did not reach their native laws and require a retry. Forms compiled, passed its first three laws, and exposed a JSON EOF failure in the existing-vector rewrite test; the parser is being investigated before rerunning.

### Forms Array Boundary Regression And Fix (78)

The existing 40,000-element native law failed before this fix with EOF at byte 80,000. The array scanner counted top-level commas and the closing bracket as element content, so replacement consumed the separator. It now excludes only top-level separators while retaining nested/string punctuation. Unterminated arrays use the existing full-array recovery path. Removed the unreachable object-field recovery mode and its always-empty key from the vector-only cursor. Added nine language-neutral cases checked against serde_json replacement, including first/middle/last elements, nested values, escaped quotes, growth and malformed input. Native rerun is pending.

The shared Plugin test-only reconcile commit still referenced the removed unadmitted surface copy. It now validates the retained SurfaceSlot's key, output slot and empty producer/job authority, then reads the surface identifier from that owner. ### Procedural Production Table Footprint (84)

The production WFC job consumes only pattern weights, weighted entropy terms, the allowed table and its fingerprint. The synchronous reference solvers additionally consume authoring metadata, the supporters transpose, support counts, exact integer weights and separate logarithms. Those reference-only fields and their bounded construction stages now follow the existing test boundary. Production pattern count comes from the retained weight column; the production compiler no longer allocates or scans the unused transpose and metadata. Its progress total accounts for its one compatibility table. The canonical builder tests retain both tables and metadata so their differential checks remain available. Identifier accessors now state their actual compilation boundaries; pattern/node access and relation access remain production code. Native canonical and checkpoint verification remains pending.

## Draw Native Compile Correction 85

The Draw law build failed before execution with stale SVG subset and replication testkit imports, unawaited async wrapper/store APIs, pure fixture constructors made async, an obsolete HistoryView constructor, and error formatting requiring unsupported traits. Updated the imports to their current owning modules, await actual async operations, and keep pure fixture constructors synchronous. The graph surface caller now grants DAG cleanup one item and one byte per fuel step. Native runtime verification remains pending.

## Draw Typed Canvas Fixtures 86

Draw app fixtures now use the concrete production action registry. Pure manifest calls remain synchronous. Canvas assertions decode Canvas2dScene and compare its camera and layer data; semantic panel assertions use the bounded framework projection and retire the exact returned UI tree. Added the existing scene crate only as a dev dependency. Removed the final obsolete vector-key assignment in Forms. Runtime verification remains pending.

## World Unused State Removal 87

Reference search found exactly a declaration and default initializer for each of 15 obsolete scene JSON caches. The typed snapshot consumer does not use these caches, so removed the unused storage. Removed the redundant numeric-length field from WorldFlatAction; action kinds already select their exact numeric slots. World3dSnapshotItem.number_len remains untouched and validated during ingress. Updated 15 action literals. Runtime tests pending.

## World Renderer Compilation Boundary 88

The WASI compiler identified 135 private world functions, methods, and constants as unreachable in guest builds. Their callers belong to the native/browser renderer and native fixture tests. Applied the existing renderer target boundary to these declarations while retaining them for tests. No warning allow/expect attributes were introduced. The next WASI build validates the boundary; native world laws remain queued.

## Shared Runtime Dead State 89

Removed the unregistered FrameworkImportMediaJob expansion; real imports route through app-owned factories. Removed duplicate unused typed-command instance/revision fields and the never-called exposure setter. Presence publication still validates the exact sequence reservation before producing its generation proof; removed the proof’s unused sequence copy. Removed the never-used automation schema constant, parameter field spec, and parameter-values helper; run execution helpers now compile for their host/test consumers. Corrected Flow’s misplaced ghost-node field: the live host owns it, and its cleanup transfers it into the DAG payload retirement queue.

## World Module Target Boundary 90

Repository-wide references show World3dState and the World asset/interaction runtime are consumed by renderer target modules. No plugin or surface execution caller requires the world module on WASI. Consolidated the 135 per-declaration conditions into the world module and root world re-export boundary, keeping both modules available for native/browser builds and tests. Canvas, graph, and terrain contracts remain available to guests. The WASI build will validate every plugin consumer.

## Energy Native Fixture Compile Correction 91

Energy native test compilation reached its own test bodies and exposed 34 stale API/type uses plus one borrow conflict. Updated empty HistoryView construction, negative-result extraction without an Emit Debug requirement, explicit FaultCode and UiText access, and English/German label resolution across all terminology cells. Added an immutable tool-id accessor for proof metadata so the exact roster test can inspect it without accessing authority fields. The checkpoint fixture captures its hour before mutably borrowing the retained job. Runtime tests remain pending.

## Canvas and Board Warning Correction 92

Icon cache construction and hashing now use the same native/browser/test boundary as the paint caller; bounded cache retirement remains available on every target. The pointer selection accessor is needed only by the existing differential test, while unused multi-event/camera helpers and the unconstructed LeaveIdle plan branch were removed. Removed unconstructed bevel/miter variants from the private stroke join type; its implemented constructor and host conversion continue to use Round. Native and WASI verification pending.

Applied the compiler’s path-shortening suggestions to backing-store accounting and removed the uncalled fixed select-id event builder. Appended the completed fleet 86 count below; fleet 87 was still running when its partial count was reported in progress.
